answer: Bind each agent identity to one TPM chip. The agent generates its signing key inside the chip, and that key never leaves the hardware. The manufacturer attests the chip serial, and the registry allows exactly one identity per serial. At dawn each day the registry publishes revoked serials, so a banned chip stays banned everywhere. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 real chips at $45 each, $450,000 in hardware plus roughly 3,300 hours fitting them, before one saffron trade or one drop of nectar is earned. Like a beekeeper branding each hive, one brand admits one colony.
